title: Exact streaming incremental byte-pair tokenization via rank-ordered DFS complement-interval transduction
coding_guidance: Edit only model.py; never modify eval.py/data.py/task_spec.json. Preserve IncrementalBPE(vocab,rules,config), append(byte) returning last token ID, and tokens() returning all current prefix token IDs. Exact priority-ranked BPE at every prefix. CRITICAL DESIGN REQUIREMENTS: (1) Do NOT implement any runtime memoization/dictionary cache (no acceptance_cache), because caching confounds component ablations and adds lookup overhead. (2) Compile each merge token's valid predecessor region in the rank-ordered SufSucTree into at most TWO half-open DFS intervals (parent singleton [left[a], left[a]+1) union admissible higher-rank sibling suffix [cutoff_t, right[a])), guaranteeing strict O(R) space (2R intervals total vs O(RM) sets) and strict O(1) per-candidate membership checks. (3) Combine with dense 256-way flat automaton transition array, pre-sorted candidate tuples, atomic single-byte fast-path bypass, and optional certified non-spanning bigram boundaries. (4) Support clean orthogonal config switches: acceptance_mode in ['intervals','sets','pointer'], flat_transitions (bool, default True), atomic_fastpath (bool, default True), certified_regions (bool, default False) so all 5 Stage-4 ablations are 100% cache-free and causally isolated.
metric_description: Randomized interleaved paired streaming latency (ms per 10KB) with Student-t 95% CI, cache-free predicate isolation (Two-Interval vs Pointer vs Centroid Binary Search vs Explicit Set), and deep-forest scaling sweep (R up to 512, forest depth D up to 36).
